_about: Trip logo (docs/specs/sprint-9/x-trip-logo.md, AC-13) - behavioural cases for a companion that has the trip-site-operations skill. WRITTEN, NOT RUN.

What is asserted in code: tests/trip-logo-skill.test.js pins that the skill TELLS the companion each of these behaviours (the workflow text), and that this file is well formed. It cannot show that a model follows the text.

What is not run: these cases against a live model. A runner would follow profile-templates/familytrip-companion/eval/needs_eval.py (spawning, environments, the refusal to write answers inside the repo): the skill as the system prompt, `state` served as tool results, every other write answered with success, then compare the calls with `expected.calls_in_order` and the reply with `reply_must` / `reply_must_not` (for a person or a grader to judge, not regex).
Everything here is fictional: no real trip, no real family. Dates are in 2027.

cases.scenario: A member (not an organizer) asks, in the family group, to change the trip logo. AC-13: the companion refuses and names who can.

message.en: Can you make this picture the trip logo? [photo attached]
message.he: אפשר לשים את התמונה הזאת בתור הלוגו של הטיול? [תמונה מצורפת]

expected.why_forbidden: The site cannot tell who asked (the tools use the trip's key), so the organizer check is the companion's. A member's request never reaches the site.

reply_must: says, in the member's language, that only an organizer can change the trip logo
names who can: Orla (by display name)
does not offer an exception and does not offer to pass the picture on by uploading it
reply_must_not: say the logo was changed, or will be
name a tool, an id or a field

cases.scenario: An organizer asks the companion to make a logo. The companion's toolset has no image-generation tool (every VM companion today). AC-13: it says it cannot make one and offers the alternative; it never calls upload_trip_logo with an image the organizer has not approved.

message.en: Can you design a logo for our trip? Something with mountains and a little train.
message.he: אפשר לעצב לנו לוגו לטיול? משהו עם הרים ורכבת קטנה.

expected.why_forbidden: There is no image the organizer has seen and approved. A placeholder, an emoji or a drawn SVG is not one.

reply_must: says plainly, in the organizer's language, that it cannot make images here
offers the alternative: make one in ChatGPT or Claude and send it over, or set it in the site's Organizer settings
says it will upload the picture once the organizer sends one
reply_must_not: describe, promise or show a logo it did not make
name a tool, an id or a field

cases.scenario: An organizer sends an image and says to make it the trip logo. The companion checks the sender, uploads, reads the answer back and reports what the site now shows.

message.en: Please make this our trip logo. [image attached]
message.he: בבקשה תעשה את זה ללוגו של הטיול שלנו. [תמונה מצורפת]

reply_must: comes only after the upload's answer says the logo is stored (source upload)
says what the site now shows: the header, the sign-in page and the browser tab
says that a phone that already has the app installed keeps its old icon and a new install gets the new one
reply_must_not: say it is done before the answer
name a tool, an id or a field

cases.scenario: The same request, on a runtime that DOES have an image-generation tool. Turn 1: one draft is made and shown, nothing is uploaded. Turn 2: only after a clear yes is it uploaded.

message.en: Can you design a logo for our trip? Something with mountains and a little train.
message.he: אפשר לעצב לנו לוגו לטיול? משהו עם הרים ורכבת קטנה.

reply_must: turn 1: shows the draft and asks whether to use it as the trip logo
turn 2: reports from the upload's answer, as in organizer_sends_an_image
reply_must_not: treat silence, or a reaction to something else, as a yes
